review.notes: Independent review of the previous head supplied the failure cases. Faults use temporary directories, fake launchd observations and injected sync boundaries; the design cannot prove a physical power loss or live macOS eligibility.

cases.description: Match installed and loaded LaunchAgent definitions, preserve absence of overrides
cases.setup: Synthetic release plist, distinct loaded arguments, wrong executable, default override and both valid override values
cases.action: Inspect and then park and recover an accepted job
cases.expected: Only recognized matching jobs are eligible. The same profile object returns, and no launchd override is created or modified.

cases.description: Recheck service and menu bar state after confirmation
cases.setup: Synthetic grouped storage, valid remote jobs, changed preferences during confirmation and either release login or old menu process
cases.action: Approve the preview, then change the fixture before pausing
cases.expected: The shared remote configuration lock and the second observations preserve the newer setting. The legacy login or process blocks with zero service or layout mutation.

cases.description: Publish durable storage and service receipts before recovery
cases.setup: Synthetic moves and injected failures in the receipt ancestor sync, layout durability barrier and receipt cleanup
cases.action: Interrupt and rerun Doctor at each failure boundary
cases.expected: No service mutation occurs before the receipt is durable; recovery waits for durable layout verification; unlink and parent sync errors retry cleanup without reapplying service actions.

cases.description: Recover services independently and bound retries of an idle job
cases.setup: Several verified jobs and an originally running service without a PID after bootstrap
cases.action: Pause, restore and rerun after a failure or idle result
cases.expected: An independent failure does not suppress separate progress, dependent jobs report their blocker, and at most one verified kickstart is attempted for a given original job.
